articles.title: A.M. Gittlitz Roots for the Mets (and a Better World)
articles.description: Through another lost season, A.M. Gittlitz, the author of a new history of New York’s underdog baseball team, is trying to hold on to hope.

articles.title: Ron Hunt, a Record-Holder for Being Hit by Pitches, Dies at 85
articles.description: Though he was notable as a Met, his record for being hit by pitches the most times in a modern-era season — 50 — came while playing for the Expos.

articles.title: Phil Regan, Dodgers’ Closer Known as the Vulture, Dies at 89
articles.description: He won 14 games in 1966 in relief, some of them following brilliant performances by the team’s starters, including Sandy Koufax, who bestowed the nickname.

articles.title: Trump’s Retribution Comes to Texas as Paxton Defeats Cornyn
articles.description: Readers discuss Senator John Cornyn’s loss to Ken Paxton in Tuesday’s Republican primary. Also: Investigating E. Jean Carroll; Mets and Knicks; religion and A.I.

articles.title: Mets Fans Are Struggling. Be Gentle.
articles.description: The Mets keep finding ways to disappoint us. And we still keep finding ways to never give up hope.

articles.title: The Secret Rooms That the Subway System Depends On
articles.description: There are 225 electrical substations in the subway system. Some of them have been around for close to 100 years.

articles.title: Is a ‘Curse of the Mambino’ Plaguing the Mets? Mamdani, Say It Ain’t So.
articles.description: On April 9, Zohran Mamdani posed for a picture with the New York Mets mascots. Since the joyous photo op, the Mets have not won a game.

articles.title: When Sports Heroes Have Terrible Opinions
articles.description: Sports used to be an oasis from political squabbling. But now the bad opinions of star athletes have become impossible to escape.

articles.title: Queens Residents Worry Over Newly Approved Casino Project
articles.description: Plans for a sprawling casino development in Flushing Meadows Corona Park spark concerns over the future of the park and the neighborhoods surrounding it.

articles.title: New Nonfiction Books to Read This Year
articles.description: Memoirs by Michael Douglas, Bob Woodward and Suge Knight; a history of the telephone; biographies of Roy Cohn and Cormac McCarthy; and much more.
